subject.title: feat(config): use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, prune them on first cleanup, or keep the numeric ring for now?
rationale: Config backups may be the only recovery copy after a bad config write, and repository policy treats config recovery and migration behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve legacy recovery points
options.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing numbered backups through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamped retention set without silent loss.

options.title: Prune legacy numbered backups
options.body: Accept a timestamp-only scheme even if the first cleanup after upgrade deletes existing `.bak.N` files.

options.title: Keep the numeric ring
options.body: Decline the naming change for now and keep the documented five-slot numeric recovery model.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy recovery points
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing numbered backups through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamped retention set without silent loss.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest available routing signal for config compatibility policy and nearby backup-maintenance history.
